$comment: Packages in package-lock.json allowed to have an install script (#104). CI installs with --ignore-scripts, so none of these scripts run; each value says why the package works anyway. Adding a key needs @dashnash's review (CODEOWNERS).

packages.esbuild: Its postinstall only checks the binary, which comes from the @esbuild/<platform> optional dependency; not run, not rebuilt.
packages.fsevents: macOS-only optional dependency of the file watchers; never installed on the Linux runners.
